prompt: A massive emerald-furred forest panther lunges through the air in a diagonal pounce, jaws clamped onto the throat of a tawny stag that buckles and collapses beneath it, the stag legs splaying as it falls. Crimson blood flecks the impact. Coarse dark-green fur on the predator, lighter brown hide on the prey for contrast. Side view, the predator looming over the prey from upper-left. The background is a dense old-growth forest in deep shadow, ferns and moss-slicked roots underfoot, dappled green light filtering through the canopy.

Two powerful forest beasts ram head-on in a violent collision, a heavy-antlered green elk and a bristling boar locking horns and tusks at the center of the frame, both fully visible and the same size, muscles straining, hooves digging into the dirt, a cloud of kicked-up dust and torn ferns between them. Coarse moss-green hide on the elk, dark bristled brown on the boar. The background is a forest clearing at dusk, dim emerald light, dense trees behind.

Low worm-eye view from the forest floor looking up at a snarling green-furred lynx mid-pounce, claws spread and jaws open, descending toward the camera, filling the upper half of the frame. In the foreground a cornered brown hare recoils, only its haunches and an ear visible at the bottom edge. Coarse mottled-green fur, claws bared. The background is towering dark trunks and a green canopy seen from below, dim filtered light.

A snarling moss-green dire wolf with bared fangs pins a thrashing brown wild boar to the forest floor, jaws sunk into the boar shoulder, the boar squealing and kicking on its back, dark crimson blood welling where the teeth bite. The wolf crouches low over its pinned prey, fur bristling. Pale brown boar hide against dark green wolf fur for contrast. The background is a shadowed forest thicket, moss-slicked logs and ferns, dappled green light.

A snarling moss-green dire wolf with bared fangs lunges in and clamps its jaws onto the neck of a thrashing brown wild boar, the two beasts colliding, the boar squealing and twisting as the wolf bites down, dark crimson blood welling where the teeth sink in. The wolf crouches low, fur bristling, driving the boar sideways. Pale brown boar hide against dark green wolf fur for contrast. The background is a shadowed forest thicket, moss-slicked logs and ferns, dappled green light.

A green-furred forest panther leaps onto the back of a fleeing brown deer, claws raking its flank and jaws reaching for the neck, the deer front legs collapsing as it goes down, dust and torn leaves flying. The panther body arcs over the deer from above. Dark emerald fur against pale tan hide. The background is a sunlit forest trail, tall trunks, green canopy light.
